body: LEAD: The transport standards are now fetched. Early architecture signal: make a same-cloud WSS relay the mandatory baseline because both devices establish outbound HTTPS/WSS and no peer NAT traversal is required; treat WebRTC only as an optional negotiated fast path because RFC 8445 ICE plus RFC 8656 TURN still require signaling and a relay fallback. Security steering accepted: I will specify separate presenter/audience origins where practical, role-separated topics/contracts, and snapshot-plus-revision reconnect. Primary evidence: RFC 6455 https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6455, RFC 8445 https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8445, RFC 8656 https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8656.
summary: WSS baseline and origin separation lead
